questions.question: Did you live on campus or off campus? *
How easy was it to find off campus housing? Any recommendations? *
questions.answer: Hard because of culture differences. We lived mixed genders. The apartment standards were also pretty low and it was difficult finding an apartment not dirty and wrecked.

questions.question: What should future exchange students know about living off campus? *
questions.answer: That it is not as easy as they say from home. It will take a long time.

questions.question: Overall, how satisfied were you with the housing available to students? *
Additional comments:
questions.answer: My apartment was broken and filled with cockroaches. Our hallway was very smelly and filled with the neighbour’s trash.

Additional comments:
questions.answer: Problem with the payment and the host’s bank.

What are the three most important things you would tell a UCPH student who is going to your host institution on exchange? *
questions.answer:
From a woman’s perspective: Dress properly, because men will call or look at you. 
Be patient when finding an apartment. 
Remember to take a break with the studies. It is a lot.

questions.question: Is there any other information that you think might prove useful to future exchange students attending your host institution? *
questions.answer: The amount of homework and preparations are a lot!
